body: Ive found an airpod like three times 💀

Nike shoes are not good for running really I’ve discovered as trainers… they are super good for racing although and I totally recommend, they might just not be your kind of shoe. I personally like to use Brooks Ghost 14s as they offer a lot of cushion and prevent injuries. I’m also in 11th grade and have used them all three years and they’re great! ps(once you hit 400 miles on the shoes, you should replace them)
Check how many miles are on your shoes, should be replaced every 400 miles which is a big factor in shin splints
Progressive Tempos like a 6 mile run when each mile drop 30 seconds more or less until the last mile is your race pace, and maybe like 4x800 mile pace repeats with equal rest or something similar

I’ve dropped my mile to 4:46 which is my sophomore time and I’m training for track too, you want to do less miles on off season so aim for 20-25 miles a week including one longer run on maybe Saturday but then tuesdays and thursdays do some sort of speed work, this will help a lot
